title: Elizondo: 'Time is not a luxury that we can afford'

tellings.quote: >> Time is not a luxury that we can afford. We we the time has come. We need to start having the conversation collectively.

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official who speaks publicly about UFOs, says the time for secrecy has run out: "Time is not a luxury that we can afford," he says. "We need to start having the conversation collectively." His words are played or quoted in an episode of Michels' show, as a call for the public to start openly discussing UFOs now.
